panels.name: Node liveness / height progress
panels.why: Covers node-down and sync-lag before responders jump into replay or consensus-specific diagnosis.

panels.name: Consensus instability / rollback pressure
panels.why: Provides one explicit first stop when availability symptoms coincide with rollback, round-change, or auth churn.

panels.name: RPC health / read surface
show: latency trend for the minimum Day-1 read path
immediately_verify: latest rollback/replay pointer if the failure followed deploy or rehearsal
panels.why: Preserves the public read surface as its own first-class operator plane.

panels.name: Worker execution / receipt flow
show: [agent] run-assigned processed=<n> skipped=<reason=count|none> ingress=<path> submit_log=<path> adapter=<name> adapter_retries=<n> adapter_backoff_ms=<n> adapter_timeout_ms=<n>
panels.why: Separates queue starvation from execution or submission failure before escalation.

panels.name: Evidence / replay integrity
show: whether replay_command= and rollback_command= were captured
whether identity fields match the assigned worktree/branch for the active rehearsal
panels.why: Makes replay-failure and contract-drift visible without relying on shell history.

panels.name: Oracle-specific drill-down
immediately_verify: evidence pointers preserved beside the dashboard snapshot
panels.why: Uses the oracle-specific contract without dropping the shared observability labels.

panels.name: Bridge relay / settlement integrity
show: settlement loop success vs failure trend
latest settlement evidence pointer or release summary.txt / manifest.txt when present
whether replay_command= and rollback_command= were captured when settlement integrity is in doubt
immediately_verify: replay/rollback pointers if integrity is in doubt
panels.why: Keeps settlement trust incidents tied to evidence and rollback state instead of a generic placeholder.

routing_overrides.why: When node availability symptoms coincide with rollback, round-change, leader-miss, or auth-replay churn, route responders to the consensus stress panel before treating the incident as pure host loss.

alert_evidence_requirements: Every sev0 / sev1 alert must preserve the shared annotation block from shared_annotation_fields.
Every first_stop value must exactly match one panel name from panels[].name.
Every alert must link summary_path and manifest_path when present; otherwise set them to unknown rather than omitting them.
If needs_rollback=yes, quote rollback_command= verbatim or record rollback=missing with rollback_command=unknown.
If observability output and emitted evidence disagree, promote the incident to service=any signal=contract-drift and route to Evidence / replay integrity first.
